$comment: Audio format constants, the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the pipeline's sample rates. Loaded at runtime: backend/audio/wake.py reads inbound, backend/audio/speak.py reads outbound. inbound = mic capture feeding wake/VAD/STT; outbound = TTS + earcons out. These lived in messages.schema.json (Contract H) until the headset was excised — they are the bridge's, not a device protocol's.
